*EDIT 2025-10-15 a long footnote 5 on subsequent Backpack developments*

On Friday, 10 October 2025, crypto markets saw $19+ billion in liquidations, the largest day ever. See also, global markets plummeted.

# preliminary statement

Mass vigilance is good! People should be able to shout "fkery" at will, and to snipe at market leaders ("punching up"). The cost of this is a lot of noise tho.

Now, to cut through the noise...

# wut happened

- binance internal policies + market structure (*i.e.*, permissionless leverage from 100k+ global degens due to an ecosystem of farming incentives) produced a weakness
- weak points got attacked for ~$200m profit
- billions of liquidations -> collateral damage (sorry)
- lower leverage overall -> is healing
- tide going out shows who was swimming naked, and/or previously unseen weak points in various systems (notably Backpack, Binance, Rabby, DeBank + other DeFi pillars)
- MM liquidity pullback was side effect of ADL consequences (internal system shows a position, reality is different a
